construct: Loss of Gsα expression/function from GNAS abnormalities impairs receptor-coupled cAMP signaling in PTH target tissues. Renal PTH resistance reduces phosphaturia and calcitriol production, producing hypocalcemia, hyperphosphatemia, and elevated PTH; some forms also have Albright hereditary osteodystrophy.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Albright hereditary osteodystrophy features plus hypocalcemia, hyperphosphatemia, elevated PTH, and mild TSH resistance identify pseudohypoparathyroidism from GNAS/Gsα signaling impairment.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Primary hypoparathyroidism has low PTH; pseudopseudohypoparathyroidism has AHO without hormone resistance; activating CASR disease has a different PTH/urinary-calcium pattern; vitamin-D-receptor resistance does not explain the classic Gsα-associated AHO/multihormone phenotype.
